prompt: Create ONE production-ready EMPTY AUGMENT CARD BACKGROUND for a cute Korean fantasy board game. A single FRONT-FACING flat UI skin, portrait aspect ratio EXACTLY 2:3, no perspective, no tilt, no tabletop or scene. Entire card fills the image, with no surrounding margin except the transparent rounded corners. This is a reusable MONOCHROME GRAYSCALE material base to be tinted different colors in game: ONLY neutral grayscale, black, charcoal, pewter gray, soft silver highlights; no hue anywhere. Design: a softly rounded thick toy-card silhouette, a hand-painted gently beveled frame with smooth pearly highlights, a fine inset stitched/embossed edge, a few restrained small rounded leaf/4-leaf-clover impressions restricted to the four outer corners. Friendly rounded Korean fantasy mobile board-game art, clean substantial shapes, restrained polished cel shading, subtle tactile painted paper / velvet material. NOT gothic, NOT baroque, NOT ornate metal filigree. Outer trim is light-medium silver gray, only 2.5 percent of total width thick, never intruding into reading areas. Layout MUST match this exact 260x390 UI: upper icon area occupies y=0% to 44% and is a deep-charcoal simple quiet recessed panel; leave it COMPLETELY EMPTY, NO circular emblem frame or icon socket, no badge, no icon. Category-label space at upper left y=2% to 8% remains quiet and plain. A delicate shallow horizontal bevel/seam near y=44.5% separates the upper panel from the lower body. Title area y=47% to 60% is a broad EMPTY dark-charcoal surface, visually only very slightly raised; NO title plaque protrusions. Description area y=62% to 96% is uninterrupted very dark matte charcoal, almost flat tone, with only extremely subtle large-scale paper shading, to support WHITE live text. Center x=7% to 93% of entire lower body must remain completely clear. Decoration only at the thin outer perimeter; absolutely no central decoration. Bottom border is thin and simple. A polished EMPTY GAME UI CARD SKIN, quiet but tactile. NO text, NO writing, NO letters, NO numbers, NO placeholder lines, NO glyphs, NO pictures, NO symbols inside panels, NO stars, NO sparkles, NO ribbons, NO medallion, NO glow cloud, NO characters, NO game pieces. Transparent outside the rounded card, opaque interior.
usage: One grayscale painted card base; category color supplied by the canvas shader. Names, rules, icons, rarity borders and hover states stay live UI elements.
qa: Source copied byte-for-byte with transparent corners. Shared base and category tint verified in six category/rarity cards and three actual draft screens, including all three blue utility cards. Small upper debug category labels removed; backdrop ignores input and live icons, rules, rarity borders and hover remain separate.
